Text:
# CV SURGERY (OPEN HEART) MVAHCS POSTOPERATIVE PROPHYLAXIS RECOMMENDATIONS

Place post-op IV antimicrobial prophylaxis orders after admission to ward.

Duration of antimicrobial prophylaxis should not exceed 24 hours. Durations longer than 24 hours have not been shown effective in preventing cardiothoracic surgical site infections. There is no benefit to continuing antimicrobial prophylaxis until all indwelling drains and intravascular catheters are removed.

# CV Surgery (including CAB and TAVR) Postoperative Prophylaxis

Cefuroxime 1.5 gm IV q8h x 1 dose post-op ($$) R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg

(pharmacy to dose) IV q12h x 1 dose post-op ($) [R]

References:

- Bratzler DW et al, Clinical Practice Guidelines for Antimicrobial Prophylaxis in
- Surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm (2013) 70:195-283
Therapy:
Alternative for patient with cephalosporin allergy
Levofloxacin has a duration of action of 24 hours. If patient received a pre-op dose of levofloxacin, a post-op dose is not required.
